review.title: Agent Review
review.description: What each agent run changed. Publish what is right; discard what is not.
review.blankDescription: When an agent writes through the MCP or agent surface, each run appears here with what it changed.
review.notePlaceholder: e.g. the tide time is wrong
review.rejectNeedsNote: The reason is recorded, and the agent can read it to fix the page.
review.keys: j/k move · x tick · a publish · h leave for later · r discard
review.appearanceSteady: Compared {{checked}} page(s): none of them look different.
review.appearanceMoved: Of {{checked}} page(s) compared, these look different: {{pages}}
review.discardLead: This undoes what the agent did:
review.discardCreated: {{count}} new page(s) go to the trash (you can restore them from there).
review.discardEdited: {{count}} edited page(s) go back to their published version. A page that was never published has nothing to go back to and stays as it is.
review.filterRuns: Filter runs by intent, agent or who ran them...
review.noMatchHint: No agent run in the queue matches these filters. Remove a chip to see more.
review.readFailedTitle: The review queue could not be read
review.readFailedHint: Nothing is missing — the server did not answer. Try again; runs waiting for you are still waiting.
review.runReadFailed: This run's changes could not be read
review.intentHint: Start a run with --intent "<sentence>" and the sentence becomes its title here.
review.nothingWaitingHint: Every one of the {{count}} runs the agent made has been decided.
